data.description: This spell allows you to turn ammunition [such as arrows, crossbow bolts, shuriken, and sling stones] into fiery projectiles. Each piece of ammunition deals an extra 1d6 points of fire damage to any target it hits. A flaming projectile can easily ignite a flammable object or structure, but it won't ignite a creature it strikes.
